properties.description: This Use Case is designed to detect failed SSH authentication attempts on the Palo Alto firewall.
properties.query:
let TriggeredTimeFrame = 24h;
let TriggeredIPs =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName == "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-038 Failed authentication PaloAlto" 
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(TriggeredTimeFrame) 
| extend A = parse_json(Entities) 
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = tostring(A.Address)
| where isnotempty(IP)
| distinct IP; 
let timeframe = 20m;
let cefpa = CommonSecurityLog1 
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeframe)
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks" 
| where Activity == "SYSTEM" 
| where isnotempty(Message)
| where Message contains "Failed password" 
//| extend User = extract("Failed password for (.+)from",1,Message) 
| extend User = trim(" ",extract("Failed password for (.+)from", 1, Message) )
| extend SourceIP = extract("(([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.(([0-9]{1,3})))",1,Message)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where SourceIP !in (vuln_scanner_IPs)
| where not (SourceIP == "10.222.68.29" and User in ("us-svc-ns-swncm","us-svc-ciscoprime","us-svc-netbrain","ACS-R218692","svcsnow","snowuser","cmdb_discovery","collectorlogin","ovoc"))  
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), count(), UserName = strcat_array(todynamic(makeset(User)),","),  DeviceName = strcat_array(todynamic(make_set(DeviceName)),",") by SourceIP,MF
| where EndTime - StartTime <= 5m
| where count_ >= 3
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP 
| extend AccountCustomEntity = UserName
| extend HostCustomEntity = DeviceName;
let syslogpa = paloaltologs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeframe)
| where Activity == "SYSTEM" 
| where SyslogMessage contains "Failed password" 
//| extend User = extract("Failed password for (.+)from",1,SyslogMessage) 
| extend User = trim(" ",extract("Failed password for (.+)from", 1, SyslogMessage) )
| extend SourceIP = extract("(([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.(([0-9]{1,3})))",1,SyslogMessage)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where SourceIP !in (vuln_scanner_IPs)
| where not (SourceIP == "10.222.68.29" and User in ("us-svc-ns-swncm","us-svc-ciscoprime","us-svc-netbrain","ACS-R218692","svcsnow","snowuser","cmdb_discovery","collectorlogin","ovoc"))  
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), count(), UserName = strcat_array(todynamic(makeset(User)),","), HostName = strcat_array(todynamic(make_set(HostName)),",") by SourceIP,MF
| where EndTime - StartTime <= 5m
| where count_ >= 3
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP 
| extend AccountCustomEntity = UserName
| extend HostCustomEntity = HostName;
cefpa | union syslogpa
